kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حَظِيَ • (ḥaẓiya) I (non-past يَحْظَى (yaḥẓā), verbal noun حُظْوَة (ḥuẓwa) or حِظْوَة (ḥiẓwa))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root ح ظ و (ḥ ẓ w). Per Wehr, also from the root ح ظ ي (ḥ ẓ y).
g: to enjoy, to be in the good graces of
to acquire, to obtain, to attain

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: حُظْوَة or حِظْوَة • (ḥuẓwa or ḥiẓwa) f (plural حُظًا (ḥuẓan, construct state حُظَا (ḥuẓā)) or حُظًى (ḥuẓan, construct state حُظَى (ḥuẓā)) or حِظًا (ḥiẓan, construct state حِظَا (ḥiẓā)) or حِظًى (ḥiẓan, construct state حِظَى (ḥiẓā)) or حُظُوَات (ḥuẓuwāt) or حِظَاء (ḥiẓāʔ) or حُظْوَات (ḥuẓwāt) or حِظْوَات (ḥiẓwāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Proto-Semitic *ḥiθ̣- (“arrow”). Everything else in the root ح ظ و (ḥ ẓ w) or ح ظ ي (ḥ ẓ y) is denominal from the originally biradical noun.
g: small headless arrow, used for playing or training
